validation.replacementApiKeyRequired: Enter the replacement API key before saving.

text.credentialWillBeRemoved: The stored credential will be removed when you save.
text.enterReplacementCredential: Enter a new credential. The stored credential remains unchanged until you save.
text.credentialRequiredWhenEnabled: Add a credential before running an import.
text.purpleAirProvidesNewMeasurementApproxima: PurpleAir provides a new measurement approximately every 2 minutes.
text.eachImportedValueRepresents2Minute: Each imported value represents a 2-minute average.
text.compassAqRecordsTimePurpleAir: CompassAQ records the time PurpleAir received the measurement.
text.compassAqImportsPurpleAirApos: CompassAQ imports PurpleAir's combined-channel particulate matter values.
text.managedAutomaticallyMeasurementTimingInf: Managed automatically. Measurement timing information is supplied and maintained by the PurpleAir importer.
text.purpleAirDevicesAirSensorsThey: PurpleAir devices are air sensors; they are not automatically regulatory instruments.
text.airGradientCredentialWorkflow: Saving this API token does not contact AirGradient. When importing linked locations is selected, enabled imports discover every location in the authenticated place. A rejected token is reported in the import run and Events.
text.airGradientReferenceWorkflow: Public references cover New York, South America, and Metro Manila without sending the token. The South America site is in São Paulo, the nearest verified active public location to Rio (366 km away). Returned coordinates must match the approved region or site.
text.airGradientAttributionWorkflow: CompassAQ preserves the acquisition path, contributor or place link when supplied, and applicable license metadata for display and CSV export.
text.importAuthenticatedLocations: Also import my AirGradient account locations
text.authenticatedLocationsHelp: By default, CompassAQ imports only its built-in public AirGradient reference locations. Check this box to also import all locations associated with this API key.

accessibility.configureExternalDataSources: Manage data sources and choose which ones are enabled.

sourceState.paid_provider_requests_disabled: Provider requests are disabled by an operator.

text.savingScheduleDoesNotContactPurple: Saving a schedule does not contact PurpleAir. An enabled schedule still requires the server paid-API gate before a run can start.
text.noSchedulesMatchedSourceNamePattern: No schedules matched this source name pattern.

clarity.ready: Saved schedule is enabled. This Data Source is ready to run.
clarity.off: Saved schedule is off. No automatic runs are scheduled.
clarity.blockedDisabled: Schedule saved. This Data Source is disabled.
clarity.blocked: Schedule saved. This Data Source is not ready to import.
clarity.unknown: Schedule saved. Data Source readiness is unavailable.
clarity.previewUnavailable: Cadence preview is unavailable. Try again, or save to validate the expression.
clarity.invalidCron: Enter a valid cron expression. For example, 0 * * * * runs hourly.
clarity.hourly: Cadence preview: every hour at minute {{minute}} (UTC).
clarity.custom: Custom cadence. The next matching times are listed below.
clarity.nextTimes: Upcoming matching times (if enabled and ready):
clarity.utcHelp: The scheduler uses UTC. A newly enabled source may also run its first import immediately.
clarity.cronHelp: Controls when imports are due. The usual five fields are minute, hour, day of month, month, and day of week. * means every value. Changes apply after saving.
clarity.timezoneHelp: This value is retained for compatibility. The current scheduler evaluates cron in UTC, regardless of this setting.
clarity.overlapLabel: Start another run while one is still running
clarity.overlapHelp: When enabled, scheduled runs may run at the same time, increasing provider requests and server load. When off, a run already in progress prevents another scheduled run from starting.
clarity.empty: No automatic import schedule is configured for this Data Source.
clarity.noUpcomingTimes: No upcoming matching times were found within the scheduler's search window.

credentialFree: Built-in. No account, API key, or configuration required.
airgradientPublicHelp: Public reference snapshots and processed 15-minute history need no API key. A key is required to import your account locations.
airgradientHistoryStream: AirGradient processed 15-minute history · underlying coverage unknown · unavailable for AQI

demo.description: While enabled, Demo Data adds current sample air-quality observations to explore CompassAQ. Demo devices and observations are not real monitoring data.
demo.setupHelp: You can turn Demo Data off later in Admin → Data Sources.
demo.disableHelp: Turning Demo Data off stops future sample observations. Existing Demo history is kept.
demo.saveFailed: The source setting could not be saved. Try again.
demo.listDescription: Continuously updated sample observations. Not real monitoring data.

workflow.missingCredential: Missing API key. Save a credential before running an import.
workflow.operatorBlocked: Provider requests are disabled by an operator.
workflow.demoAutomatic: Demo Data generates sample observations automatically while enabled. Manual imports are not supported.
